query: INSERT INTO rate_windows(key_id,window_start,events,bytes) VALUES($1,date_trunc('minute',clock_timestamp()),$2,$3) ON CONFLICT(key_id,window_start) DO UPDATE SET events=rate_windows.events+EXCLUDED.events,bytes=rate_windows.bytes+EXCLUDED.bytes WHERE rate_windows.events+EXCLUDED.events<=$4 AND rate_windows.bytes+EXCLUDED.bytes<=$5 RETURNING events
